title: Choose your features
description: Plan an OpenSP feature set and the SP buttons that open it.
introduction: Pick the features you want, then choose the buttons that open each one.
planningNote: This is a configuration preview. You can save your choices now; a compatible firmware build and website upload are still in development.
targetNote: Feature adapters are specific to a firmware version. Choose the base you want to use; this page cannot identify the firmware on your SP.
featureNote: Select a feature to include it in your plan. The evidence label describes the current implementation.
releaseScope: The first release focuses on Synth, global recording and USB updates. Autotune and stem splitting are planned for later.
shortcutNote: Choose two or three physical SP controls. Hold the first controls, then press the last. Each shortcut opens its feature once; all controls must be released before it can open again.
samplerShortcutScope: Requested scope: idle sampler/Generator lifecycle. This does not require audio transport to stop. Press the final control last, then release all controls to rearm.
normalUiShortcutScope: Requested preview scope: normal sampler, pattern, FX or utility screens. These screen restrictions have not been verified on the SP yet. The scope says nothing about USB audio transport.
unregisteredShortcutScope: No shortcut scope is registered for this feature.
shortcutLimit: These are requested shortcuts. The current firmware uses fixed entry controls; applying your choices needs the shared firmware dispatcher.
emptyShortcuts: Select a feature above to choose its shortcut.
emptySummary: No features selected. Choose a feature to start a configuration.
memoryNote: Memory use is checked after the selected features are linked together. Individual prototype sizes cannot establish whether a combined build fits.
receiptNote: Choose a local JSON receipt to compare it with your current choices. Only metadata is checked; firmware files and device results remain unverified.
receiptLimit: JSON, up to 128 KiB. This check does not connect to your SP.
storageUnavailable: Browser storage is unavailable. Export your configuration to keep it.
transferNote: You will be able to change this selection one feature at a time. The verified USB writer installs a complete APP1 firmware image, so a changed selection currently needs a newly composed image and a full update.
transferLimit: Independent feature uploads and runtime hot swapping have not been verified. USB installation requires the matching writer, chip/profile checks, full flash readback, a separate status check and a real reboot.
recordingNote: The global recorder is being built to capture screens and controls outside Synth, with audio recorded separately over USB. Its current adapter targets Roland v5.52. The installed P6S recorder has a physical synth screen/audio result; global recording and adapters for other firmware remain unqualified.
noScript: Enable JavaScript to edit, import or export a configuration. The feature status and update limits are available below.
footer: Feature configuration preview. No device connection.
